Drum-bus membership is a creative parameter
Section automation outranks a single drum preset

rules.when_to_apply: reference-conditioned rock or metal style transfer
rules.what_to_change: add per-section and per-role constraints plus manual override
rules.verify: loudness-matched blind A/B against global-only and manual variants
rules.undo_when: role constraints reduce coherence or contradict section intent

rules.when_to_apply: predicted fixed chain adds processing without demonstrated need
rules.what_to_change: search effect bypass, selection and order before continuous parameters
rules.verify: equal-loudness fixed-chain versus selected-chain versus manual-chain A/B
rules.undo_when: search variance hurts repeatability without audible benefit

rules.what_to_change: sweep every exposed parameter and calculate output/null deltas
rules.verify: directionally plausible nonzero changes on synthetic and musical signals
rules.undo_when: parameter is intentionally inert and removed from public control surface

rules.when_to_apply: automatic DRC cannot beat untreated balance repeatably
rules.what_to_change: keep no-compression branch in search and evaluation
rules.verify: loudness-matched blind A/B versus at least one light treatment
rules.undo_when: untreated dynamics create repeatable balance or audibility failure

rules.what_to_change: treat LRA as advisory feature constrained by role, section and perception
rules.verify: section-wise listening plus envelope and crest diagnostics against no DRC
rules.undo_when: LRA guidance repeatedly selects worse blind-rated variants

rules.when_to_apply: parallel compression raises cymbal/hat spill or breaks room continuity
rules.what_to_change: compare shell-only, shell-heavy weighted full-kit and current routing
rules.verify: matched-loudness A/B in dense chorus and sparse verse
rules.undo_when: excluding ambience makes the kit detached or sample-like

rules.when_to_apply: bus compression loses attack or pumps from kick low end
rules.what_to_change: jointly test attack, release, detector weighting or HPF and wet/dry
rules.verify: matched-loudness A/B plus GR timing for kick and snare
rules.undo_when: meter improvement reduces blind-rated energy or size

rules.when_to_apply: one static drum ambience setting makes verse oversized or chorus undersized
rules.what_to_change: create section candidates for room level/width, parallel send, close-mic level and reverb
rules.verify: blind full-song pass and loudness-matched section-loop A/B
rules.undo_when: automation is audible as a technical jump or fights song dynamics

experiments.title: global versus role-and-section rock reference conditioning
no DRC versus light cross-adaptive versus manual per-role

handoff: Do not trust one global reference vector for rock. Validate every exposed DDSP parameter with a sensitivity/null test. Keep no-compression as a candidate. Compare shell-only and weighted full-kit parallel routing.
